modelLimits: This remains an illustrative fictional two-species island model, not a Galapagos reconstruction or an empirical forecast.
The comparison follows a founding event, not a population maintained at six individuals.
Repeated founder boats share the same fixed ancestral genotype pool; they are not independent source populations.
Observed ranges are not confidence intervals, significance tests, or guaranteed patterns.
Neutral marker H = 2p(1-p) describes one marker; founder-copy identities track ancestry, not different allele types or genome-wide diversity.
Private paired worlds share an initial breeding seed; later random draw sequences can differ. Matching numbered IDs in different private worlds do not identify a shared organism.
Archived recipes are validated, bounded and flattened. Outcomes and full genealogies are recomputed; untrusted saved outcomes are not used.
Editing or revisiting private voyages leaves the original expedition and its random future unchanged.
